title: Role-based Views
seo: Role-based dashboard views and access control
meta: Show each role only the screens and data it needs, with permissions checked on the server. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Role-based views, the right screens for each role
overview: A manager, an agent and a client should not all see the same dashboard. We set up role-based views so each person sees the menus, buttons, numbers and records that fit their job. We define the roles with you, hide what a role should not see, and also block it on the server, so someone cannot reach hidden data by typing a web address. We test each role.

faq: Is hiding a button enough for security?
No. Hidden buttons are only a convenience. We also check permission on the server for every request, so a blocked user gets nothing even if they find the web address.
Can I change roles later without a developer?
With the Premium package, yes, through an admin page. With the smaller packages, roles are set in code, and we leave notes showing how to add or edit one.
Do you need my users to log in again?
Usually no. Roles are read from your existing user records. If your sign-in system needs changes to carry roles, we explain it first and agree the work in writing.
Does this work with my existing login?
Yes, if your login already identifies users, such as Auth0, Firebase or your own system. If it does not, our sign-up and login service can be added first.
